## RemindersClient interface

The Reminders client: one namespace per resource that has operations, plus the app's own commands. A client factory creates one from `remindersContract` in the app's `/contract` entry. Its type carries the contract's resource table, [RemindersResources](./reminders_contract.remindersresources.md)<!-- -->, so references can be bound to it by resource; the brand has no runtime member.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface RemindersClient extends ClientBrand<RemindersResources>
```

**Extends:** [ClientBrand](./contracts.clientbrand.md)<!-- -->&lt;[RemindersResources](./reminders_contract.remindersresources.md)<!-- -->&gt;
